query: What phased timeline, key milestones, team roles and a rough budget estimate are realistic for a 12–18 month pilot-to-full project rollout?

response.query: What phased timeline, key milestones, team roles and a rough budget estimate are realistic for a 12–18 month pilot-to-full project rollout?
response.answer: A 12-18 month project typically includes phases: planning, design, implementation, testing, and go-live. Key roles: project manager, IT team, and end-users. Budget estimate: $500,000 to $2 million.

results.title: ERP Implementation Project Plan & Timeline - Visual South
results.content: # ERP Implementation Project Plan & Timeline. However, what’s typically the same for just about all small to medium-sized ERP implementations are the core phases and tasks to get from purchasing your new solution, to going live with it, and beyond. This blog will discuss Visual South’s methodology for an ERP implementation project plan. Use these links to jump to a specific phase of our ERP implementation plan:. Once an ERP solution has been selected, the first phase of the implementation begins. Part of this phase in your ERP implementation project plan also includes network/hardware requirements and installation–unless you’ve chosen a cloud-based SaaS model ERP such as Infor CloudSuite Industrial. The implementation planning meeting takes place, led by the ERP vendor and including the core members of the customer’s team. After the meeting, the vendor puts together an ERP implementation project plan for the execution of the solution. In phase III of the ERP implementation plan, end-user training begins.
